turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in class. Who decided that?
Funny. Who entered the zero, Hale, and before anyone spoke to Owen?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You're accusing my son with no document on the table. Show me what you have, or I'm going to the principal.
